votes.motion: Approve meeting minutes of July 11, 2023 and August 8, 2023.
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from its July 11, 2023 and August 8, 2023 sessions.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda (setting the date of Tuesday, November 14, 2023 at 2 p.m. to accept public comment and consider adopting a resolution amending the RDA budget for Fiscal Year 2023-24, Budget Amendment No. 1).
votes.description: The Board set a future public hearing date to consider RDA Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY 2023-24, which includes a housekeeping transfer of funds to a City grant account for improved tracking and compliance reporting while maintaining the use of funds for affordable housing.
